In the event of any conflict between these excerpts and the full Operating Agreement, the full Operating Agreement shall control.

**[2.2 Excerpt --- Article III: Management and Authority (Section 3.1 --- Managing Member)]{.underline}**

The following is excerpted from Article III, Section 3.1 of the Operating Agreement:

> *Section 3.1 --- Managing Member.* **Elena Vasquez-Torres** shall serve as the sole Managing Member of the Company. The Managing Member shall have the exclusive authority to manage the day-to-day operations and affairs of the Company, including without limitation: (a) entering into contracts on behalf of the Company in the ordinary course of business; (b) hiring and terminating employees, contractors, and consultants; (c) making capital expenditure decisions with respect to the Project in amounts not exceeding Five Hundred Thousand Dollars (\$500,000) individually (any single expenditure in excess of \$500,000 shall require the prior approval of Members holding a majority in interest of the outstanding membership interests); (d) executing loan documents, promissory notes, deeds of trust, and related instruments on behalf of the Company; and (e) managing and overseeing the construction and development of the Project, including selection of architects, general contractors, and subcontractors.
>
> *Section 3.2 --- Major Decisions.* Notwithstanding the foregoing, the following actions shall require the prior written approval of Members holding at least seventy-five percent (75%) of the outstanding membership interests: (a) any sale, transfer, or encumbrance of all or substantially all of the Company\'s assets; (b) any financing or refinancing of the Property in a principal amount in excess of One Million Dollars (\$1,000,000); (c) the admission of any new Member to the Company; (d) any amendment to this Operating Agreement; and (e) any voluntary dissolution of the Company or the filing of any petition for relief under any federal or state bankruptcy or insolvency law.

The approval threshold of 75% means that Elena Vasquez-Torres (62%) cannot unilaterally approve any major decision. She would require the concurrence of at least one additional member. Combined with Brightleaf Investors Group LLC (28%), the two members hold 90%, which exceeds the 75% threshold. Combined with Reginald K. Osei (10%), Ms. Vasquez-Torres and Mr. Osei hold 72%, which falls below the 75% threshold. Consequently, Brightleaf Investors Group LLC holds an effective veto right over major decisions, as no combination of the other two members alone can reach the required supermajority.

The Operating Agreement, as currently in effect, does not contain any provision requiring the appointment of an independent director or independent manager for the Company. There are no separateness covenants requiring the Company to maintain its own books, records, and bank accounts separate from those of its members or their affiliates, no prohibition on commingling of funds with affiliates, and no requirement that the Company obtain a non-consolidation opinion. These provisions are customarily required by institutional lenders in single-purpose entity structures.

**[2.3 Excerpt --- Article V: Capital Contributions (Section 5.1 --- Initial Capital Contributions; Section 5.3 --- Additional Capital Calls)]{.underline}**

The following is excerpted from Article V, Sections 5.1 and 5.3 of the Operating Agreement:

> *Section 5.1 --- Initial Capital Contributions.* Each Member shall make the following initial capital contributions to the Company:
>
> \(a\) **Elena Vasquez-Torres** shall contribute that certain real property located at 601 and 615 Foster Street, Durham, Durham County, North Carolina 27701 (Parcel IDs: 0821-04-72-3341 and 0821-04-72-4102), together with all improvements, easements, and appurtenances thereto, valued at Eight Million Two Hundred Thousand Dollars (\$8,200,000) (acquisition cost basis), in exchange for a sixty-two percent (62%) membership interest in the Company.
>
> \(b\) **Brightleaf Investors Group LLC** shall make an initial capital contribution of Zero Dollars (\$0) at the time of formation. Brightleaf Investors Group LLC shall receive a twenty-eight percent (28%) membership interest in the Company in consideration of its commitment to arrange third-party mezzanine financing for the Project and to contribute future capital as and when called by the Managing Member in accordance with Section 5.3 of this Agreement.
>
> \(c\) **Reginald K. Osei** shall make an initial capital contribution of Zero Dollars (\$0) at the time of formation. Reginald K. Osei shall receive a ten percent (10%) membership interest in the Company in consideration of development management services to be provided to the Company in connection with the Project and his commitment to contribute future capital as and when called by the Managing Member in accordance with Section 5.3 of this Agreement.
>
> *Section 5.3 --- Additional Capital Calls.* The Managing Member may, from time to time, issue capital calls to all Members pro rata in proportion to their respective membership interests, upon not less than thirty (30) days\' prior written notice. Capital calls shall be at the sole discretion of the Managing Member for purposes of funding Project costs not covered by loan proceeds or other available funds. Any Member who fails to fund a capital call within the applicable notice period shall be subject to dilution of such Member\'s membership interest on a two-to-one (2:1) penalty basis, as calculated in accordance with Schedule B attached hereto.

As reflected above, Brightleaf Investors Group LLC received its 28% membership interest not in exchange for a cash capital contribution but in consideration of its commitment to arrange third-party mezzanine financing for the Project. That mezzanine financing was arranged through Brightleaf Mezzanine Capital LLC, an entity under the common control of Thomas R. Chen, who also serves as Managing Member of Brightleaf Investors Group LLC. The Borrower\'s cash equity position is therefore entirely dependent on the land contribution made by Elena Vasquez-Torres.

**[2.4 Excerpt --- Article VI: Distributions (Section 6.1 --- Distribution Waterfall)]{.underline}**

The following is excerpted from Article VI, Section 6.1 of the Operating Agreement:

> *Section 6.1 --- Distribution Waterfall.* Distributable Cash (as defined in Section 1.1 of this Agreement, being the net cash from operations of the Company or net proceeds from a Capital Event, in each case after payment of all Company obligations, including without limitation debt service on all loans (including the senior construction loan, any mezzanine or subordinate financing, and any other indebtedness of the Company), required reserves, and operating expenses) shall be distributed to the Members in the following order of priority:
>
> \(a\) **First**, to all Members pro rata in proportion to their respective membership interests, until each Member has received a cumulative return equal to a nine percent (9.0%) per annum preferred return on such Member\'s unreturned capital contribution (as calculated on a non-compounded basis from the date of such contribution);
>
> \(b\) **Second**, to all Members pro rata in proportion to their respective membership interests, until each Member has received a return of one hundred percent (100%) of such Member\'s unreturned capital contribution; and
>
> \(c\) **Third**, the balance, if any, shall be distributed seventy percent (70%) to Elena Vasquez-Torres (as the Managing Member), twenty percent (20%) to Brightleaf Investors Group LLC, and ten percent (10%) to Reginald K. Osei (the \"Promote Split\").

The distribution waterfall expressly provides that debt service on \"all loans,\" including any mezzanine or subordinate financing, constitutes a Company obligation that must be satisfied before any distributions are made to the Members. This structure places the mezzanine loan from Brightleaf Mezzanine Capital LLC --- an affiliate of the 28% member, Brightleaf Investors Group LLC --- at a priority ahead of member distributions, further intertwining the financial relationship between the Borrower, its equity members, and the mezzanine lender.

**[2.5 Excerpt --- Article IX: Transfer Restrictions (Section 9.1 --- Restrictions on Transfer)]{.underline}**

The following is excerpted from Article IX, Section 9.1 of the Operating Agreement:

> *Section 9.1 --- Restrictions on Transfer.* No Member may sell, assign, transfer, pledge, encumber, hypothecate, or otherwise dispose of all or any portion of such Member\'s membership interest in the Company without the prior written consent of the Managing Member and Members holding at least seventy-five percent (75%) of the outstanding membership interests. Notwithstanding the foregoing, a Member may pledge such Member\'s membership interest to a lender as collateral for a bona fide loan, provided that such pledge has been approved in writing by the Managing Member. Any purported transfer in violation of this Section 9.1 shall be null and void and of no force or effect.

The Operating Agreement permits pledges of membership interests with Managing Member approval but does not distinguish between a pledge to the senior lender and a pledge to the mezzanine lender, nor does it address relative priority between competing pledges of the same membership interests. As noted in Section 1.2 above, the mezzanine lender (Brightleaf Mezzanine Capital LLC) currently holds a pledge of 100% of the membership interests in the Borrower as security for the mezzanine loan. If the senior construction lender, Pinnacle Savings Bank, N.A., also requires a pledge of 100% of the membership interests as collateral for the senior loan, the Operating Agreement provides no mechanism to resolve conflicting first-priority claims on the same collateral. The resolution of priority as between the competing pledges is expected to be addressed by the intercreditor agreement between Pinnacle Savings Bank, N.A. and Brightleaf Mezzanine Capital LLC, which has been negotiated but is not yet executed as of the date hereof.

"""Generate a .docx from markdown via Pandoc with an optional reference template.

Usage:
    python generate_from_md.py input.md output.docx [template.docx]

Pandoc applies the template's paragraph and run styles to your markdown.
Best for reports/memos/letters where the template carries firm styling.

Requires pandoc on PATH.
"""
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def generate(md_path: Path, output_path: Path, template_path: Path | None = None):
    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cmd = ["pandoc", str(md_path), "-o", str(output_path)]
    if template_path is not None:
        cmd.append(f"--reference-doc={template_path}")
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        print(f"pandoc failed: {result.stderr}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    print(f"OK: wrote {output_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) not in (3, 4):
        print("Usage: generate_from_md.py <input.md> <output.docx> [template.docx]", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
    template = Path(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) == 4 else None
    generate(Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2]), template)

from docx import Document

from docx.enum.section import WD_SECTION
from docx.oxml.ns import qn

doc = Document()

sec = doc.sections[0]
sec.top_margin = Inches(1.0); sec.bottom_margin = Inches(1.0)
sec.left_margin = Inches(1.0); sec.right_margin = Inches(1.0)

def set_font(style, name='Times New Roman', size=None, bold=None, italic=None, color=None, caps=None):
    f = style.font
    f.name = name
    if size: f.size = Pt(size)
    if bold is not None: f.bold = bold
    if italic is not None: f.italic = italic
    if color: f.color.rgb = color
    if caps is not None: f.all_caps = caps
    rpr = style.element.get_or_add_rPr()
    rf = rpr.find(qn('w:rFonts'))
    if rf is None:
        rf = OxmlElement('w:rFonts'); rpr.append(rf)
    for a in ('w:ascii','w:hAnsi','w:cs','w:eastAsia'):
        rf.set(qn(a), name)

st = doc.styles
normal = st['Normal']
set_font(normal, size=11)
normal.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(8)
normal.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.08
normal.paragraph_format.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY
normal.paragraph_format.widow_control = True

title = st['Title']
set_font(title, size=20, bold=True, color=RGBColor(0x1F,0x33,0x4E))
title.paragraph_format.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
title.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)

sub = st['Subtitle']
set_font(sub, size=12, bold=False, italic=True, color=RGBColor(0x33,0x33,0x33))
sub.paragraph_format.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
sub.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(14)

h1 = st['Heading 1']
set_font(h1, size=11.5, bold=True, color=RGBColor(0x1F,0x33,0x4E), caps=True)
h1.paragraph_format.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
h1.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(16)
h1.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(10)
h1.paragraph_format.keep_with_next = True

h2 = st['Heading 2']
set_font(h2, size=11, bold=True, color=RGBColor(0x1F,0x33,0x4E))
h2.paragraph_format.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT
h2.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(12)
h2.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(5)
h2.paragraph_format.keep_with_next = True

h3 = st['Heading 3']
set_font(h3, size=11, bold=True, italic=True, color=RGBColor(0x33,0x33,0x33))
h3.paragraph_format.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT
h3.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(10)
h3.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)
h3.paragraph_format.keep_with_next = True

for name in ('Body Text',):
    s = st[name]; set_font(s, size=11)
    s.paragraph_format.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY
    s.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(8)

# compact style for exhibit lists (used via pandoc 'compact' on tight lists)
for name in ('Compact','First Paragraph','Block Text','Table Caption','Image Caption','Footnote Text'):
    try:
        s = st[name]; set_font(s, size=9.5 if name=='Footnote Text' else 11)
        s.paragraph_format.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY
        s.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)
    except KeyError:
        pass

# header / footer
hdr = sec.header
hp = hdr.paragraphs[0]
hp.text = ""
hp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.RIGHT
r = hp.add_run("")
r.font.size = Pt(8); r.font.name='Times New Roman'

ftr = sec.footer
fp = ftr.paragraphs[0]
fp.text = ""
fp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
def add_field(par, instr):
    r1 = par.add_run(); fc = OxmlElement('w:fldChar'); fc.set(qn('w:fldCharType'),'begin'); r1._r.append(fc)
    r2 = par.add_run(); it = OxmlElement('w:instrText'); it.set(qn('xml:space'),'preserve'); it.text = instr; r2._r.append(it)
    r3 = par.add_run(); fc2 = OxmlElement('w:fldChar'); fc2.set(qn('w:fldCharType'),'separate'); r3._r.append(fc2)
    r4 = par.add_run("1")
    r5 = par.add_run(); fc3 = OxmlElement('w:fldChar'); fc3.set(qn('w:fldCharType'),'end'); r5._r.append(fc3)
    for rr in (r1,r2,r3,r4,r5):
        rr.font.size = Pt(8); rr.font.name='Times New Roman'
add_field(fp, " PAGE ")

doc.save('work/reference.docx')
print("saved")

# ARTICLE I — DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION

## 1.1 Defined Terms

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
As used in this Agreement, the following terms have the meanings set forth below. Terms defined elsewhere in this Agreement have the meanings there ascribed to them.

**"Advance"** means any disbursement of Loan proceeds hereunder, including the initial Advance made on the Closing Date and each subsequent Advance made pursuant to Article IV.

**"Affiliate"** means, with respect to any Person, any other Person that directly or indirectly Controls, is Controlled by, or is under common Control with such Person. For the avoidance of doubt, each of Brightleaf Investors Group LLC, Brightleaf Mezzanine Capital LLC, and Thomas R. Chen is an Affiliate of Borrower for purposes of this Agreement.

**"Applicable Rate"** means, (a) at any time during the period from the Closing Date through and including the Construction Maturity Date, the greater of (i) Daily Simple SOFR plus three and twenty-five hundredths percent (3.25%) per annum and (ii) four and twenty-five hundredths percent (4.25%) per annum, and (b) at any time after the Construction Maturity Date, the greater of (i) Daily Simple SOFR plus three and fifty hundredths percent (3.50%) per annum and (ii) four and fifty hundredths percent (4.50%) per annum, in each case calculated on the basis of a 360-day year for the actual number of days elapsed.

**"Approved Plans and Specifications"** means the plans and specifications for the Project prepared by the Project Architect, dated [●], as approved by Lender in writing pursuant to Section 6.3, as the same may be amended, supplemented or modified from time to time with Lender's prior written consent as required hereunder.

**"Approved Project Budget"** means the Project Budget attached as Exhibit B, totaling $56,700,000, together with each line-item and aggregate modification thereof approved in writing by Lender.

**"Architect Agreement"** means the agreement between Borrower and the Project Architect for the design and construction administration of the Project, as collaterally assigned to Lender pursuant to the Architect Assignment.

**"Assignment of Rents"** means the Assignment of Rents and Leases dated as of the Closing Date from Borrower to Lender, as the same may be amended, restated or supplemented from time to time.

**"Available Cash"** means, as of any date, cash and Cash Equivalents of Borrower held in Eligible Accounts, excluding (a) the Interest Reserve Balance, (b) amounts held in the Equity Escrow Account, and (c) tenant security deposits and other funds held in trust.

**"Bankruptcy Code"** means Title 11 of the United States Code, 11 U.S.C. § 101 et seq., as amended.

**"Business Day"** means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday or day on which commercial banks in Charlotte, North Carolina are authorized or required by law to close.

**"Capital Event"** means any sale, transfer, refinancing, recapitalization or other liquidity event with respect to the Property or the Project, or any sale or transfer of a direct or indirect equity interest in Borrower.

**"Cash Equivalents"** means (a) marketable direct obligations of the United States or any agency thereof maturing within one year, (b) certificates of deposit or time deposits of any bank having capital and surplus of not less than $500,000,000, maturing within one year, and (c) money market funds investing at least ninety-five percent (95%) of their assets in the foregoing.

**"Change Order"** has the meaning given in Section 4.9.

**"Closing Date"** means the date on which the initial Advance is made under the Loan, which the parties anticipate will be February 28, 2025.

**"Code"** means the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.

**"Completion Guaranty"** means the Completion Guaranty dated as of the Closing Date executed by the Guarantors in favor of Lender.

**"Construction Contract"** means the guaranteed maximum price construction contract between Borrower and the General Contractor, dated [●], 2024, in the guaranteed maximum price amount of $34,750,000, as collaterally assigned to Lender pursuant to the Construction Contract Assignment.

**"Construction Contract Assignment"** means the Collateral Assignment of Construction Contract dated as of the Closing Date from Borrower to Lender.

**"Construction Documents"** means, collectively, the Construction Contract, the Architect Agreement, and all other contracts, subcontracts, purchase orders, plans, specifications, drawings, permits and approvals relating to the design or construction of the Project.

**"Construction Maturity Date"** means the date that is thirty (30) months after the Closing Date; provided that if the Closing Date is February 28, 2025, the Construction Maturity Date shall be August 28, 2027.

**"Construction Period"** means the period from the Closing Date through and including the Construction Maturity Date.

**"Construction Schedule"** means the critical-path construction schedule for the Project attached as Exhibit D, as updated monthly pursuant to Section 6.10 and approved by Lender.

**"Control"** means the possession, directly or indirectly, of the power to direct or cause the direction of the management or policies of a Person, whether through the ownership of voting securities, by contract, or otherwise, and includes the holding of a membership interest that confers the right to designate or remove the managing member of a limited liability company.

**"Daily Simple SOFR"** means, for any day, the greater of (a) the rate per annum equal to the secured overnight financing rate as administered by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York (or a successor administrator) for U.S. Government Securities Business Day that is five (5) U.S. Government Securities Business Days prior to such day, and (b) the SOFR Floor.

**"Deed of Trust"** means the Deed of Trust, Assignment of Rents, Security Agreement and Fixture Filing dated as of the Closing Date, from Borrower, as grantor, to a trustee reasonably acceptable to Lender, for the benefit of Lender, encumbering the Property, as the same may be amended, restated or supplemented from time to time.

**"Default Rate"** means, at any time, the Applicable Rate plus five percent (5.00%) per annum, but in no event exceeding the Maximum Lawful Rate.

**"Developer Fee"** means the developer fee in the amount of $2,835,000 included in the Approved Project Budget, subject to Section 7.5 and Section 6.11.

**"Distributions"** means any dividend, distribution, return of capital, loan or advance to, or other payment or transfer of value by Borrower to or for the benefit of any member of Borrower or any Affiliate of any member, including (a) any repayment of, or payment of interest on, any member loan or advance (including any advance used to acquire the Property or to fund remediation of the Property), and (b) any payment of the Developer Fee other than as expressly permitted by Section 7.5.

**"DSCR"** means, as of any date of determination, the ratio of (a) Net Operating Income for the applicable measurement period to (b) Debt Service for such period, calculated in accordance with Section 8.3 and Section 8.8.

**"Debt Service"** means, for any period, the aggregate interest expense that would accrue during such period on the outstanding principal balance of the Loan at the Applicable Rate then in effect (determined on an interest-only basis), plus, after the commencement of amortization, scheduled principal.

**"Debt Yield"** means, as of any date of determination, the ratio (expressed as a percentage) of (a) Net Operating Income for the most recent twelve (12) month period (annualized in accordance with Section 8.8) to (b) the outstanding principal balance of the Loan.

**"Eligible Account"** means a deposit account maintained with Lender or with a depository institution acceptable to Lender that has executed a deposit account control agreement in favor of Lender in form and substance satisfactory to Lender.

**"Environmental Indemnity"** means the Environmental Indemnity Agreement dated as of the Closing Date executed by Borrower and the Guarantors in favor of Lender.

**"Environmental Laws"** means all federal, state and local statutes, regulations, ordinances, orders, permits and directives relating to pollution, human health, hazardous substances, petroleum products, wetlands, stormwater and the environment, including CERCLA, RCRA, the Clean Water Act, the Clean Air Act, the Toxic Substances Control Act, and the North Carolina Oil Pollution and Hazardous Substances Control Act (N.C.G.S. Chapter 143, Article 21B), the North Carolina Inactive Hazardous Sites Response Act (N.C.G.S. Chapter 130A, Article 9) and the North Carolina Groundwater Classification and Standards rules (15A N.C.A.C. 2L).

**"Environmental Restricted Area"** means the approximately 0.38-acre area in the northeast corner of Parcel 0821-04-72-4102 that is subject to the land use restriction set forth in the NFA Letter and the Deed Notice, as depicted on the survey and on Exhibit E, which area shall be delineated by metes and bounds in the Deed Notice and verified by the Survey.

**"Equity Escrow Account"** means the segregated escrow account established with Lender or the Title Company pursuant to Section 3.1(k) and the Equity Escrow Agreement.

**"Equity Escrow Agreement"** means the Equity Escrow and Disbursement Agreement among Borrower, Lender and the escrow agent named therein, in form and substance satisfactory to Lender.

**"Equity Escrow Deposit"** means the deposit of not less than $2,140,000 in cash required by Section 3.1(k).

**"Event of Default"** has the meaning given in Section 14.1.

**"Extension Option"** has the meaning given in Section 2.17.

**"Fee"** and **"Fees"** means, collectively, the Origination Fee, the Unused Line Fee, the Exit Fee, the Extension Fee and each other fee payable by Borrower under this Agreement or the other Loan Documents.

**"GAAP"** means generally accepted accounting principles in the United States, consistently applied.

**"General Contractor"** means Graystone Construction Group Inc., a North Carolina corporation (NC General Contractor License No. 78442), or any replacement general contractor approved by Lender in writing.

**"Guarantor"** means, individually, each of Elena Vasquez-Torres and Reginald K. Osei, and **"Guarantors"** means both of them, together with any additional guarantor that becomes party to a Guaranty.

**"Guaranties"** means, collectively, the Completion Guaranty, the Carry Guaranty, the Partial Repayment Guaranty, and each other guaranty, indemnity, surety or support agreement now or hereafter delivered to Lender in connection with the Loan.

**"Highest Lawful Rate"** means the maximum non-usurious rate of interest permitted by applicable North Carolina law, determined in accordance with N.C.G.S. § 24-1.1 and § 24-2.

**"Indebtedness"** means, without duplication, all principal, interest, fees, costs, expenses, indemnities and other amounts payable by Borrower or any Guarantor under the Loan Documents.

**"Initial Advance"** means the Advance of $9,475,000 to be made on the Closing Date.

**"Intercreditor Agreement"** means the intercreditor and subordination agreement among Lender, the Mezzanine Lender and Borrower, in form and substance satisfactory to Lender in its sole discretion.

**"Interest Reserve"** means the amount of $4,850,000 funded from Loan proceeds on the Closing Date and held in the Interest Reserve Account.

**"Interest Reserve Account"** means the segregated sub-account of the Loan established and maintained by Lender as a ledger sub-account pursuant to Section 4.5.

**"Interest Reserve Balance"** means, as of any date, the undisbursed balance of the Interest Reserve held by Lender.

**"Lien"** means any mortgage, deed of trust, deed to secure debt, pledge, security interest, lien, charge, hypothecation, assignment, encumbrance, judgment lien, mechanic's or materialmen's lien, or other preferential arrangement of any kind, including any conditional sale or title retention arrangement.

**"Loan"** means the construction-to-mini-permanent loan made by Lender to Borrower pursuant to this Agreement in the principal amount of $47,500,000.

**"Loan Amount"** means $47,500,000.

**"Loan Documents"** means this Agreement, the Note, the Deed of Trust, the Assignment of Rents, the Security Agreement, the Construction Contract Assignment, the Architect Assignment, the Pledge Agreements, the Guaranties, the Environmental Indemnity, the Equity Escrow Agreement, any Interest Rate Cap Agreement, and each other document, instrument, certificate or agreement now or hereafter executed and delivered by Borrower, any Guarantor or any other Person to or for the benefit of Lender in connection with the Loan, as each may be amended, restated or supplemented from time to time.

**"Loan-to-Cost Ratio"** or **"LTC"** has the meaning given in Section 8.1.

**"Loan-to-Value Ratio"** or **"LTV"** has the meaning given in Section 8.2.

**"Material Adverse Effect"** means a material adverse effect on (a) the business, assets, liabilities, financial condition or results of operations of Borrower, any Guarantor or the Project, (b) the value, use or marketability of the Property or any other Collateral, (c) the ability of Borrower or any Guarantor to perform its obligations under the Loan Documents, or (d) the enforceability or priority of any Lien granted to Lender under the Loan Documents.

**"Maturity Date"** means the Mini-Perm Maturity Date, or, if the Extension Option is exercised in accordance with Section 2.17, the Extended Maturity Date.

**"Maximum Lawful Rate"** means the Highest Lawful Rate.

**"Membership Interest Pledge"** means the pledge of one hundred percent (100%) of the membership interests in Borrower granted to Lender pursuant to the Pledge Agreements, which pledge shall constitute a first-priority perfected security interest.

**"Mezzanine Documents"** means the Mezzanine Loan agreement, the mezzanine pledge agreement, and each other document evidencing, securing or relating to the Mezzanine Loan.

**"Mini-Perm Maturity Date"** means the date that is twelve (12) months after the Construction Maturity Date; provided that if the Construction Maturity Date is August 28, 2027, the Mini-Perm Maturity Date shall be August 28, 2028.

**"Mini-Perm Period"** means the period from the day following the Construction Maturity Date through and including the Maturity Date.

**"Net Operating Income"** or **"NOI"** means, for any period, the actual gross revenues of the Property from all sources for such period, less actual operating expenses of the Property for such period, determined in accordance with GAAP consistently applied and Lender's customary underwriting adjustments, and excluding (a) capital expenditures, (b) debt service, (c) depreciation and amortization, (d) income and franchise taxes, (e) the Developer Fee, (f) non-recurring items, and (g) any revenue attributable to units or space that are not lawfully permitted to be occupied or leased.

**"NFA Letter"** means the No Further Action determination letter dated September 30, 2024 issued by NCDEQ, Inactive Hazardous Sites Branch, for Site ID IHSB-24-1203 / Incident No. NONUST-24-0847, as the same may be modified by NCDEQ from time to time in accordance with Section 10.4.

**"NCDEQ"** means the North Carolina Department of Environmental Quality, or any successor agency.

**"Note"** means the promissory note dated as of the Closing Date in the original principal amount of $47,500,000 executed by Borrower and payable to the order of Lender.

**"OFAC"** means the U.S. Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control.

**"Permitted Exceptions"** means, collectively, the matters listed on Exhibit H, as the same may be modified with Lender's prior written consent.

**"Person"** means any individual, corporation, limited liability company, partnership, joint venture, trust, estate, unincorporated organization, governmental authority or other entity.

**"Pledge Agreements"** means, collectively, the Membership Interest Pledge Agreements dated as of the Closing Date executed by each member of Borrower in favor of Lender, together with the accompanying UCC-1 financing statements and, where applicable, control agreements.

**"Project"** means the ground-up construction of a six-story (five residential stories over a one-story podium), Class A mixed-use residential and retail development containing 212 residential units (142 one-bedroom, 56 two-bedroom and 14 three-bedroom units), approximately 18,400 square feet of ground-floor retail space in seven retail bays, a four-level structured parking garage containing 276 spaces, approximately 287,500 square feet of gross building area, and related amenities, improvements, site work and appurtenances, on the Property.

**"Project Architect"** means Meridian Design Collective PC, a North Carolina professional corporation, or any replacement architect approved by Lender in writing.

**"Project Budget"** means the budget of Total Project Costs attached as Exhibit B.

**"Project Costs"** and **"Total Project Costs"** have the meanings given in Section 8.1.

**"Related Entities"** means each member of Borrower, each Affiliate of Borrower, the Mezzanine Lender, and each Person under common Control with any of the foregoing.

**"Requisition"** means a draw request and advance certificate substantially in the form of Exhibit J.

**"Retainage"** means, with respect to each Advance for Hard Costs, an amount equal to ten percent (10%) of such Hard Costs, held back and released in accordance with Section 4.3.

**"SOFR Floor"** means one percent (1.00%) per annum.

**"Substantial Completion"** means completion of the Project in accordance with the Approved Plans and Specifications such that the Project is ready for its intended occupancy and use, as evidenced by (a) the issuance of a certificate of occupancy (temporary or final) by the City of Durham for all residential units and retail space, (b) the Project Architect's certificate of substantial completion (AIA G704 or equivalent), and (c) Lender's receipt of a certification from the Construction Inspector confirming substantial completion.

**"Survey"** means the ALTA/NSPS Land Title Survey of the Property prepared in accordance with the 2021 ALTA/NSPS Minimum Standard Detail Requirements, including Table A items [1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7(a), 7(b)(1), 8, 9, 10, 11, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20 and 21] as specified by Lender, certified to Lender, the Title Company and Borrower, dated or re-certified not more than ninety (90) days prior to the Closing Date, and otherwise in form and substance satisfactory to Lender.

# ARTICLE II — THE LOAN

## 2.1 The Commitment

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement and the other Loan Documents, and in reliance on the representations, warranties and covenants of Borrower and the Guarantors, Lender agrees to make Advances to Borrower from time to time during the Construction Period in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed Forty-Seven Million Five Hundred Thousand and No/100 Dollars ($47,500,000), in accordance with the Draw Schedule attached as Exhibit C. The Loan is a single-advance, non-revolving construction facility permitting multiple disbursements in accordance with Article IV. No principal amount repaid or prepaid may be re-borrowed. Borrower's obligation to repay the Loan is evidenced by the Note and secured by the Security Documents.
:::

## 2.2 The Note

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
The Loan shall be evidenced by the Note, which shall bear interest and be payable as provided in this Agreement and in the Note. In the event of any conflict between the Note and this Agreement, this Agreement shall control.
:::

## 2.3 Purpose

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
The proceeds of the Loan shall be used solely to (a) pay Hard Costs and Soft Costs set forth in the Approved Project Budget, (b) fund the Interest Reserve, and (c) pay the Origination Fee to the extent permitted by the Approved Project Budget. No proceeds of the Loan shall be used (i) to pay any Distribution, (ii) to repay, reimburse or refinance any capital contribution, member loan or other advance made by any member of Borrower (including any advance used to acquire the Property or to fund the remediation of the Property) except as expressly permitted in Section 7.5(f), (iii) to pay any amount in respect of the Mezzanine Loan, or (iv) for any purpose that would cause the Loan-to-Cost Ratio or the Loan-to-Value Ratio to exceed the limitations in Article VIII.
:::

## 2.4 Interest

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
(a) **Applicable Rate.** Interest on the outstanding principal balance of the Loan shall accrue at all times at the Applicable Rate.

(b) **Payment.** Interest shall be calculated on the basis of a 360-day year and the actual number of days elapsed, and shall be payable monthly in arrears on the first (1st) Business Day of each calendar month, commencing on the first Business Day of the first full calendar month following the Closing Date.

(c) **Construction Period Interest; Interest Reserve.** During the Construction Period, and for so long as the Interest Reserve Balance is sufficient to pay interest then due, interest shall be funded by disbursements from the Interest Reserve Account as provided in Section 4.5. When and to the extent the Interest Reserve Balance is insufficient to pay interest when due, Borrower shall pay such interest from its own funds, and the Guarantors shall be obligated to do so pursuant to the Carry Guaranty, in each case without notice, demand or grace period beyond the third (3rd) Business Day following such insufficiency.

(d) **Mini-Perm Period Interest.** From and after the Construction Maturity Date, interest shall be payable by Borrower monthly in arrears from Borrower's own funds. No portion of the Interest Reserve may be applied to interest accruing after the Construction Maturity Date.
:::

## 2.5 SOFR; Benchmark Replacement; Conforming Changes

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
(a) **Daily Simple SOFR.** If Lender determines that Daily Simple SOFR cannot be determined in accordance with its definition for any day, the rate for that day shall be the most recently published Daily Simple SOFR, and the next Business Day on which Daily Simple SOFR is determinable shall apply. Lender's determination of the Applicable Rate shall be conclusive absent manifest error.

(b) **Benchmark Transition.** If Lender determines in its reasonable discretion that (i) Daily Simple SOFR has been permanently or indefinitely discontinued or is no longer representative, (ii) the administrator of Daily Simple SOFR has made a public statement to that effect, or (iii) the regulatory supervisor of the administrator has made a public statement to that effect, then Lender may designate a replacement benchmark rate, giving due consideration to (A) any replacement rate or successor rate then recommended for the applicable loan type by the Alternative Reference Rates Committee ("**ARRC**") and (B) any evolving or then-prevailing market convention for syndicated and commercial real estate construction loans in the United States for such replacement. Lender shall determine any spread adjustment (including any ARRC-recommended spread adjustment) and any conforming changes to the definition of Business Day, the interest payment dates, the lookback period and the timing and frequency of rate determinations. Lender shall provide Borrower with not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice of any such designation.

(c) **Conforming Changes.** Lender may make conforming changes to the timing and manner of determining the Applicable Rate, the interest payment dates and the lookback period, and such changes shall become effective without further consent of Borrower; provided that no such change shall increase the aggregate amount of interest payable by more than the sum of the applicable spread adjustment plus the replacement benchmark rate would produce.

(d) **SOFR Floor.** The SOFR Floor shall apply notwithstanding any discontinuation, replacement or negative rate.
:::

## 2.6 Default Rate

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of any Event of Default, the outstanding principal balance of the Loan and, to the extent permitted by applicable law, all other amounts payable hereunder (including past-due interest) shall bear interest at the Default Rate, compounded as provided in the Note, from the date of such Event of Default until the earlier of (a) the date on which such Event of Default is cured in a manner acceptable to Lender and (b) the date on which the Indebtedness is paid in full. The application of the Default Rate is not a waiver of, and does not cure, any Event of Default, and is in addition to all other remedies available to Lender. In no event shall the Default Rate exceed the Maximum Lawful Rate.
:::

## 2.7 Payments; Application

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
All payments shall be made in immediately available funds to the account designated by Lender in writing, not later than 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time on the due date. Lender shall apply each payment in the following order: (a) costs, expenses and indemnities then due; (b) Fees then due; (c) accrued and unpaid interest (including Default Rate interest); (d) principal (including any mandatory curtailment); and (e) all other amounts. Lender may reorder the application of payments to the extent permitted by law or if an Event of Default exists. Payments received after 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time shall be deemed received on the next Business Day.
:::

## 2.8 Computation; Rate Quotation

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
Interest shall be computed on the basis of a 360-day year for the actual number of days elapsed. Upon Borrower's written request (not more frequently than monthly), Lender shall provide a written statement of the Daily Simple SOFR rate then in effect and the resulting Applicable Rate.
:::

## 2.9 Fees

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
(a) **Origination Fee.** Borrower shall pay Lender an origination fee equal to one percent (1.00%) of the Loan Amount, or $475,000, payable in full on the Closing Date and fundable from the Initial Advance in accordance with the Approved Project Budget.

(b) **Unused Line Fee.** Borrower shall pay Lender an unused line fee at the rate of twenty-five hundredths of one percent (0.25%) per annum on the average daily undrawn amount of the commitment (calculated as the Loan Amount less the sum of the outstanding principal balance of the Loan and the Interest Reserve Balance), payable quarterly in arrears commencing on the first quarterly date following the Closing Date and on the date on which the Loan is paid in full. Borrower acknowledges that the unused line fee is an additional cost of the Loan that is not funded by any line item of the Approved Project Budget and shall be paid from Borrower's own funds.

(c) **Exit Fee.** Borrower shall pay Lender an exit fee, payable on the date the Loan is repaid in full, equal to: (i) one-half of one percent (0.50%) of the outstanding principal balance of the Loan at the time of repayment if the Loan is repaid at any time during the Construction Period; (ii) one-quarter of one percent (0.25%) of the outstanding principal balance of the Loan at the time of repayment if the Loan is repaid during the first six (6) months following the Construction Maturity Date; and (iii) zero (0%) if the Loan is repaid after the first six (6) months following the Construction Maturity Date. The exit fee is consideration for Lender's commitment to make the Loan and is not a prepayment premium.

(d) **Extension Fee.** If the Extension Option is exercised, Borrower shall pay Lender an extension fee equal to one-quarter of one percent (0.25%) of the then-outstanding principal balance of the Loan on or before the Mini-Perm Maturity Date.

The Loan is a single-advance, non-revolving construction facility permitting multiple disbursements in accordance with Article IV. No principal amount repaid or prepaid may be re-borrowed. ::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
The proceeds of the Loan shall be used solely to (a) pay Hard Costs and Soft Costs set forth in the Approved Project Budget, (b) fund the Interest Reserve, and (c) pay the Origination Fee to the extent permitted by the Approved Project Budget. ::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
(a) **Applicable Rate.** Interest on the outstanding principal balance of the Loan shall accrue at all times at the Applicable Rate.

(c) **Construction Period Interest; Interest Reserve.** During the Construction Period, and for so long as the Interest Reserve Balance is sufficient to pay interest then due, interest shall be funded by disbursements from the Interest Reserve Account as provided in Section 4.5. (d) **Mini-Perm Period Interest.** From and after the Construction Maturity Date, interest shall be payable by Borrower monthly in arrears from Borrower's own funds. No portion of the Interest Reserve may be applied to interest accruing after the Construction Maturity Date.

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}

Lender's determination of the Applicable Rate shall be conclusive absent manifest error.

(b) **Benchmark Transition.** If Lender determines in its reasonable discretion that (i) Daily Simple SOFR has been permanently or indefinitely discontinued or is no longer representative, (ii) the administrator of Daily Simple SOFR has made a public statement to that effect, or (iii) the regulatory supervisor of the administrator has made a public statement to that effect, then Lender may designate a replacement benchmark rate, giving due consideration to (A) any replacement rate or successor rate then recommended for the applicable loan type by the Alternative Reference Rates Committee ("**ARRC**") and (B) any evolving or then-prevailing market convention for syndicated and commercial real estate construction loans in the United States for such replacement. Lender shall determine any spread adjustment (including any ARRC-recommended spread adjustment) and any conforming changes to the definition of Business Day, the interest payment dates, the lookback period and the timing and frequency of rate determinations. Lender shall provide Borrower with not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice of any such designation.

(c) **Conforming Changes.** Lender may make conforming changes to the timing and manner of determining the Applicable Rate, the interest payment dates and the lookback period, and such changes shall become effective without further consent of Borrower; provided that no such change shall increase the aggregate amount of interest payable by more than the sum of the applicable spread adjustment plus the replacement benchmark rate would produce.

(d) **SOFR Floor.** The SOFR Floor shall apply notwithstanding any discontinuation, replacement or negative rate.
:::

## 2.6 Default Rate

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of any Event of Default, the outstanding principal balance of the Loan and, to the extent permitted by applicable law, all other amounts payable hereunder (including past-due interest) shall bear interest at the Default Rate, compounded as provided in the Note, from the date of such Event of Default until the earlier of (a) the date on which such Event of Default is cured in a manner acceptable to Lender and (b) the date on which the Indebtedness is paid in full. The application of the Default Rate is not a waiver of, and does not cure, any Event of Default, and is in addition to all other remedies available to Lender. In no event shall the Default Rate exceed the Maximum Lawful Rate.
:::

## 2.7 Payments; Application

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
All payments shall be made in immediately available funds to the account designated by Lender in writing, not later than 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time on the due date. Lender shall apply each payment in the following order: (a) costs, expenses and indemnities then due; (b) Fees then due; (c) accrued and unpaid interest (including Default Rate interest); (d) principal (including any mandatory curtailment); and (e) all other amounts. # ARTICLE III — CONDITIONS PRECEDENT TO CLOSING

## 3.1 Conditions Precedent

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
Lender's obligation to make the Initial Advance is subject to the prior or simultaneous satisfaction (or written waiver by Lender) of each of the following conditions, each in form and substance satisfactory to Lender and its counsel:

(a) **Loan Documents.** Execution and delivery of this Agreement, the Note, the Deed of Trust, the Assignment of Rents, the Security Agreement, the Construction Contract Assignment, the Architect Assignment, the Pledge Agreements, the Guaranties, the Environmental Indemnity, the Equity Escrow Agreement and each other Loan Document, together with all schedules, exhibits and UCC-1 financing statements required by Lender, in each case duly authorized, executed, acknowledged where required, and delivered.

(b) **Senior Loan Committee Approval.** Written approval of the Loan by Lender's Senior Loan Committee, in the amount and on the terms set forth in the Credit Memorandum, which approval shall not have been withdrawn, conditioned in a manner inconsistent with this Agreement, or expired.

Chen. **This condition may not be waived.**

(d) **Organizational Documents; Member Consents.** Delivery of (i) certified copies of Borrower's Articles of Organization and Amended and Restated Operating Agreement, as amended as required by Section 3.1(e) and Section 9.2, (ii) a certificate of good standing from the North Carolina Secretary of State dated not more than thirty (30) days prior to the Closing Date, and (iii) a unanimous written consent of all members of Borrower holding one hundred percent (100%) of the membership interests, expressly authorizing the Loan, the execution and delivery of the Loan Documents, the granting of the Liens (including the Membership Interest Pledge), the amendment of the Operating Agreement required hereby, the recording of the Deed Notice, and the transactions contemplated by the Intercreditor Agreement.

Borrower shall deliver evidence reasonably satisfactory to Lender of the appointment of the Independent Manager concurrently with the Closing Date.

(f) **Non-Consolidation Opinion.** Delivery of a reasoned non-consolidation opinion of Calloway & Strauss PLLC, Borrower's counsel, addressed to Lender and dated the Closing Date, opining that, on the basis of the assumptions and qualifications stated therein and applying North Carolina law (with such reference to Delaware and other authority as counsel deems appropriate), a bankruptcy court would not substantively consolidate the assets and liabilities of Borrower with those of any Related Entity.

Chen, Brightleaf Investors Group LLC, or any entity under common Control with any of the foregoing, including source-of-funds documentation and a certification of Borrower's Managing Member. **Drafting Note:** The Term Sheet does not impose an equity escrow condition, and the Credit Memorandum presents the equity escrow and a reduction of the Loan Amount as alternatives. # ARTICLE IV — ADVANCES; DISBURSEMENT PROCEDURES; INTEREST RESERVE

## 4.1 Advances Generally

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
Lender shall make Advances in accordance with the Draw Schedule attached as Exhibit C. Each Advance shall be in the amount and for the milestone set forth in the Draw Schedule, and the aggregate of all Advances shall not exceed the Loan Amount. Lender's obligation to make any Advance is subject to (a) the satisfaction of each condition in Section 4.2 and (b) the absence of any Event of Default and of any condition that with notice or lapse of time, or both, would constitute an Event of Default. Amounts identified in the Draw Schedule as "contingency" or "developer fee" are not scheduled disbursements; they shall be advanced only upon Lender's written approval following satisfaction of Section 4.10 (contingency) or Section 7.5 (developer fee), respectively. **Drafting Note:** The Draw Schedule as delivered schedules contingency and developer fee amounts in Draws 2 through 9 notwithstanding that those items are reserves under the Approved Project Budget. See Cover Memorandum, Issue 11.
:::

## 4.2 Conditions Precedent to Each Advance

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
Lender's obligation to make any Advance (including the Initial Advance and each subsequent Advance) is subject to the satisfaction of each of the following conditions as of the date of the Advance:

(a) **No Default.** No Event of Default, and no condition that with notice or lapse of time, or both, would constitute an Event of Default, shall exist under any Loan Document, the Mezzanine Documents or the Intercreditor Agreement.

(b) **Representations True.** Each representation and warranty in Article V and in each other Loan Document shall be true and correct in all material respects as of the date of the Advance with the same effect as if made on that date.

(c) **Requisition.** Delivery of a Requisition in the form of Exhibit J, executed by Borrower and certified by the Managing Member, not less than fifteen (15) days prior to the requested Advance date, together with the supporting documentation described in Section 4.2(d) through (j).

(d) **AIA Application for Payment.** A completed AIA Application and Certificate for Payment (Form G702) and Continuation Sheet (Form G703), certified by the Project Architect and the General Contractor, allocating the requested amount among the line items of the Approved Project Budget.

(e) **Construction Inspector's Report.** A report from the Construction Inspector (engaged by Lender at Borrower's expense) confirming (i) achievement of the milestone for the requested Advance, (ii) the percentage of completion claimed, (iii) that the work complies with the Approved Plans and Specifications, (iv) that the remaining undisbursed Loan proceeds and Borrower's committed equity are sufficient to complete the Project free of liens, and (v) the absence of defective work or material cost overruns.

(f) **Lien Waivers.** Conditional partial lien waivers in the statutory form prescribed by N.C.G.S. § 44A-23 (for the General Contractor, upon receipt of payment) and N.C.G.S. § 44A-24 (for subcontractors and materialmen) from the General Contractor and each subcontractor and materialman that has furnished labor or materials through the prior draw period, together with a certification from the General Contractor that all such waivers have been obtained and that no claimant has asserted a claim of lien.

(g) **Title Date-Down.** A date-down or bring-down endorsement to the Title Policy from the Title Company, effective as of a date not more than ten (10) days prior to the Advance, confirming the continued first-priority status of the Deed of Trust and the absence of any intervening Lien or encumbrance other than the Permitted Exceptions.

(h) **Interest Reserve Adequacy Test.** Evidence that the Interest Reserve Adequacy Test in Section 4.5(d) is satisfied, together with Borrower's deposit of any additional amount required by Section 4.5(e).

(i) **Equity First.** With respect to every Advance other than the Initial Advance, the Equity Escrow Deposit shall have been fully disbursed and applied to Project Costs in accordance with the Equity Escrow Agreement. **Drafting Note:** The "equity first" requirement of the Credit Memorandum conflicts with the Initial Advance of $9,475,000 made at zero percent (0%) completion, which disburses one hundred percent (100%) of Soft Costs, the entire Interest Reserve and the Origination Fee before any Borrower equity is at risk. See Cover Memorandum, Issue 10.

(j) **Insurance; Compliance Certificate.** Evidence of continued compliance with Article XI, and a compliance certificate in the form of Exhibit I certifying as to each financial covenant in Article VIII and each representation in Article V.

(k) **Budget Reconciliation.** An updated sources-and-uses reconciliation and construction budget reconciliation demonstrating that (i) the Project remains within the Approved Project Budget, (ii) no cost overrun exists, or, if one exists, that Borrower has deposited the amount of the overrun in accordance with Section 4.10, and (iii) the remaining undisbursed Loan proceeds plus Borrower's available equity are sufficient to complete the Project.

(l) **No Material Adverse Change.** No Material Adverse Effect shall have occurred since the Closing Date or the immediately preceding Advance.

(m) **Environmental Compliance.** Evidence of compliance with each condition of the NFA Letter and Article X, including, if construction has reached the Environmental Restricted Area, evidence that the conditions of Section 10.6 have been satisfied.
:::

## 4.3 Retainage

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
Lender shall retain, from each Advance for Hard Costs, Retainage equal to ten percent (10%) of the Hard Costs covered by such Advance, resulting in aggregate Retainage of $3,475,000 (10% of the $34,750,000 GMP). Retainage shall be released as the final Advance (Draw 9) only upon satisfaction of each of the following: (a) issuance of a final certificate of occupancy by the City of Durham for all residential units and retail space in the Project; (b) delivery of final, unconditional lien waivers from the General Contractor, all subcontractors and all materialmen in the statutory forms prescribed by N.C.G.S. § 44A-23 and § 44A-24; (c) delivery of the Project Architect's certificate of final completion; (d) expiration of the one hundred twenty (120) day period for filing a claim of lien under N.C.G.S. § 44A-12, or, in the alternative, delivery of a lien bond in form and amount satisfactory to Lender; (e) delivery of as-built plans and specifications and all warranties, guaranties and manuals; and (f) confirmation from the Construction Inspector that the Project has been completed in accordance with the Approved Plans and Specifications and that no punch-list item exceeding $[50,000] in the aggregate remains outstanding. **Drafting Note:** The Term Sheet and the Credit Memorandum fix the retainage release at $3,275,000, which is $200,000 less than the 10% Retainage of $3,475,000 required by the same documents. The $200,000 difference is unexplained and must be reconciled. See Cover Memorandum, Issue 12.
:::

## 4.4 Disbursement Mechanics

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
(a) Lender shall use commercially reasonable efforts to fund each approved Advance within ten (10) Business Days after Lender's receipt of a complete and conforming Requisition and all supporting documentation.

(b) Lender may, at its election, disburse any Advance directly to the Title Company for disbursement pursuant to the Title Company's closing and disbursement instructions, and Borrower's execution of a Requisition shall constitute irrevocable authorization for such direct disbursement.

(c) Lender shall not be obligated to make any Advance in an amount in excess of the lesser of (i) the amount requested and approved and (ii) the amount remaining available under the Loan Amount after reserving (A) the undisbursed Retainage, (B) the Interest Reserve Balance required for the remainder of the Construction Period, and (C) Lender's reasonable estimate of the cost to complete the Project.

(d) If Lender determines at any time that the undisbursed Loan proceeds, together with Borrower's committed and available equity, are insufficient to complete the Project free of liens, Lender may (i) suspend further Advances, and (ii) require Borrower or the Guarantors to deposit the deficiency with Lender. Any such deposit shall be held and disbursed by Lender for Project Costs before any further Advance is made.

(e) Lender's approval of any Advance shall not constitute approval of the work or a waiver of any defect, and shall not relieve Borrower, the General Contractor or the Project Architect of any obligation.
:::

## 4.5 Interest Reserve

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
(a) **Funding.** On the Closing Date, Lender shall fund the Interest Reserve of $4,850,000 from the proceeds of the Initial Advance, and shall record the Interest Reserve as a ledger sub-account of the Loan (the **"Interest Reserve Account"**). The Interest Reserve is not a segregated deposit of Borrower and does not constitute trust funds; amounts disbursed from the Interest Reserve Account are applied to interest accruing on the Loan and do not reduce the outstanding principal balance of the Loan, except to the extent the Loan Documents provide otherwise.

(b) **Application.** So long as the Interest Reserve Balance is sufficient, Lender shall apply the Interest Reserve to interest accruing on the Loan during the Construction Period on each interest payment date. The Interest Reserve shall not be applied to principal, Fees, Default Rate interest, or interest accruing after the Construction Maturity Date.

(c) **Statement.** Lender shall deliver to Borrower, concurrently with each monthly interest statement, a reconciliation of the Interest Reserve Balance, the interest accrued during the period, and the projected remaining interest cost through the Construction Maturity Date.

(d) **Interest Reserve Adequacy Test.** At each Requisition, and in any event not less frequently than quarterly, Lender shall perform an adequacy test comparing (i) the Interest Reserve Balance to (ii) the projected interest cost through the earlier of the next anticipated Advance date or ninety (90) days from the date of the test, in each case determined at the Applicable Rate then in effect and the then-projected outstanding principal balance (the **"Interest Reserve Adequacy Test"**). **Drafting Note:** The Draw Schedule's own analysis projects a surplus of $221,325 assuming Daily Simple SOFR of 3.50%; the same analysis at 4.35% (the rate used throughout the Credit Memorandum and the Term Sheet) projects a shortfall of approximately $365,830; and the Credit Memorandum projects a shortfall of $565,000. The three results cannot all be correct. See Cover Memorandum, Issues 7 and 8.

(e) **Replenishment.** If the Interest Reserve Adequacy Test is not satisfied at any time, Borrower shall, within five (5) Business Days after written notice from Lender (and, if the deficiency is identified in connection with a Requisition, before the requested Advance is funded), deposit into the Interest Reserve Account an amount sufficient to satisfy the test. All such deposits shall be made from Borrower's own funds, and may not be made from Loan proceeds, Mezzanine Loan proceeds, or any Distribution.

(f) **Guarantor Backstop.** If Borrower fails to fund any deposit required by Section 4.5(e), the Guarantors shall be obligated to fund such amount on demand pursuant to the Carry Guaranty.

(g) **No Waiver.** Lender's acceptance of any deposit or its failure to perform the Interest Reserve Adequacy Test at any time shall not constitute a waiver of Borrower's obligations under this Section, nor a release of the Guarantors under the Carry Guaranty.
:::

# ARTICLE IV — ADVANCES; DISBURSEMENT PROCEDURES; INTEREST RESERVE

## 4.1 Advances Generally

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
Lender shall make Advances in accordance with the Draw Schedule attached as Exhibit C. Each Advance shall be in the amount and for the milestone set forth in the Draw Schedule, and the aggregate of all Advances shall not exceed the Loan Amount. Lender's obligation to make any Advance is subject to (a) the satisfaction of each condition in Section 4.2 and (b) the absence of any Event of Default and of any condition that with notice or lapse of time, or both, would constitute an Event of Default. Amounts identified in the Draw Schedule as "contingency" or "developer fee" are not scheduled disbursements; they shall be advanced only upon Lender's written approval following satisfaction of Section 4.10 (contingency) or Section 7.5 (developer fee), respectively. **Drafting Note:** The Draw Schedule as delivered schedules contingency and developer fee amounts in Draws 2 through 9 notwithstanding that those items are reserves under the Approved Project Budget. See Cover Memorandum, Issue 11.
:::

## 4.2 Conditions Precedent to Each Advance

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
Lender's obligation to make any Advance (including the Initial Advance and each subsequent Advance) is subject to the satisfaction of each of the following conditions as of the date of the Advance:

(a) **No Default.** No Event of Default, and no condition that with notice or lapse of time, or both, would constitute an Event of Default, shall exist under any Loan Document, the Mezzanine Documents or the Intercreditor Agreement.

(b) **Representations True.** Each representation and warranty in Article V and in each other Loan Document shall be true and correct in all material respects as of the date of the Advance with the same effect as if made on that date.

(c) **Requisition.** Delivery of a Requisition in the form of Exhibit J, executed by Borrower and certified by the Managing Member, not less than fifteen (15) days prior to the requested Advance date, together with the supporting documentation described in Section 4.2(d) through (j).

(d) **AIA Application for Payment.** A completed AIA Application and Certificate for Payment (Form G702) and Continuation Sheet (Form G703), certified by the Project Architect and the General Contractor, allocating the requested amount among the line items of the Approved Project Budget.

(e) **Construction Inspector's Report.** A report from the Construction Inspector (engaged by Lender at Borrower's expense) confirming (i) achievement of the milestone for the requested Advance, (ii) the percentage of completion claimed, (iii) that the work complies with the Approved Plans and Specifications, (iv) that the remaining undisbursed Loan proceeds and Borrower's committed equity are sufficient to complete the Project free of liens, and (v) the absence of defective work or material cost overruns.

(f) **Lien Waivers.** Conditional partial lien waivers in the statutory form prescribed by N.C.G.S. § 44A-23 (for the General Contractor, upon receipt of payment) and N.C.G.S. § 44A-24 (for subcontractors and materialmen) from the General Contractor and each subcontractor and materialman that has furnished labor or materials through the prior draw period, together with a certification from the General Contractor that all such waivers have been obtained and that no claimant has asserted a claim of lien.

(g) **Title Date-Down.** A date-down or bring-down endorsement to the Title Policy from the Title Company, effective as of a date not more than ten (10) days prior to the Advance, confirming the continued first-priority status of the Deed of Trust and the absence of any intervening Lien or encumbrance other than the Permitted Exceptions.

(h) **Interest Reserve Adequacy Test.** Evidence that the Interest Reserve Adequacy Test in Section 4.5(d) is satisfied, together with Borrower's deposit of any additional amount required by Section 4.5(e).

(i) **Equity First.** With respect to every Advance other than the Initial Advance, the Equity Escrow Deposit shall have been fully disbursed and applied to Project Costs in accordance with the Equity Escrow Agreement. **Drafting Note:** The "equity first" requirement of the Credit Memorandum conflicts with the Initial Advance of $9,475,000 made at zero percent (0%) completion, which disburses one hundred percent (100%) of Soft Costs, the entire Interest Reserve and the Origination Fee before any Borrower equity is at risk. See Cover Memorandum, Issue 10.

(j) **Insurance; Compliance Certificate.** Evidence of continued compliance with Article XI, and a compliance certificate in the form of Exhibit I certifying as to each financial covenant in Article VIII and each representation in Article V.

(k) **Budget Reconciliation.** An updated sources-and-uses reconciliation and construction budget reconciliation demonstrating that (i) the Project remains within the Approved Project Budget, (ii) no cost overrun exists, or, if one exists, that Borrower has deposited the amount of the overrun in accordance with Section 4.10, and (iii) the remaining undisbursed Loan proceeds plus Borrower's available equity are sufficient to complete the Project.

(l) **No Material Adverse Change.** No Material Adverse Effect shall have occurred since the Closing Date or the immediately preceding Advance.

(m) **Environmental Compliance.** Evidence of compliance with each condition of the NFA Letter and Article X, including, if construction has reached the Environmental Restricted Area, evidence that the conditions of Section 10.6 have been satisfied.
:::

## 4.3 Retainage

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
Lender shall retain, from each Advance for Hard Costs, Retainage equal to ten percent (10%) of the Hard Costs covered by such Advance, resulting in aggregate Retainage of $3,475,000 (10% of the $34,750,000 GMP). Retainage shall be released as the final Advance (Draw 9) only upon satisfaction of each of the following: (a) issuance of a final certificate of occupancy by the City of Durham for all residential units and retail space in the Project; (b) delivery of final, unconditional lien waivers from the General Contractor, all subcontractors and all materialmen in the statutory forms prescribed by N.C.G.S. § 44A-23 and § 44A-24; (c) delivery of the Project Architect's certificate of final completion; (d) expiration of the one hundred twenty (120) day period for filing a claim of lien under N.C.G.S. § 44A-12, or, in the alternative, delivery of a lien bond in form and amount satisfactory to Lender; (e) delivery of as-built plans and specifications and all warranties, guaranties and manuals; and (f) confirmation from the Construction Inspector that the Project has been completed in accordance with the Approved Plans and Specifications and that no punch-list item exceeding $[50,000] in the aggregate remains outstanding. **Drafting Note:** The Term Sheet and the Credit Memorandum fix the retainage release at $3,275,000, which is $200,000 less than the 10% Retainage of $3,475,000 required by the same documents. The $200,000 difference is unexplained and must be reconciled. See Cover Memorandum, Issue 12.
:::

## 4.4 Disbursement Mechanics

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
(a) Lender shall use commercially reasonable efforts to fund each approved Advance within ten (10) Business Days after Lender's receipt of a complete and conforming Requisition and all supporting documentation.

(b) Lender may, at its election, disburse any Advance directly to the Title Company for disbursement pursuant to the Title Company's closing and disbursement instructions, and Borrower's execution of a Requisition shall constitute irrevocable authorization for such direct disbursement.

(c) Lender shall not be obligated to make any Advance in an amount in excess of the lesser of (i) the amount requested and approved and (ii) the amount remaining available under the Loan Amount after reserving (A) the undisbursed Retainage, (B) the Interest Reserve Balance required for the remainder of the Construction Period, and (C) Lender's reasonable estimate of the cost to complete the Project.

(d) If Lender determines at any time that the undisbursed Loan proceeds, together with Borrower's committed and available equity, are insufficient to complete the Project free of liens, Lender may (i) suspend further Advances, and (ii) require Borrower or the Guarantors to deposit the deficiency with Lender. (e) Lender's approval of any Advance shall not constitute approval of the work or a waiver of any defect, and shall not relieve Borrower, the General Contractor or the Project Architect of any obligation.
:::

::: {custom-style="Body Text"}
(a) **Funding.** On the Closing Date, Lender shall fund the Interest Reserve of $4,850,000 from the proceeds of the Initial Advance, and shall record the Interest Reserve as a ledger sub-account of the Loan (the **"Interest Reserve Account"**). The Interest Reserve is not a segregated deposit of Borrower and does not constitute trust funds; amounts disbursed from the Interest Reserve Account are applied to interest accruing on the Loan and do not reduce the outstanding principal balance of the Loan, except to the extent the Loan Documents provide otherwise.

(b) **Application.** So long as the Interest Reserve Balance is sufficient, Lender shall apply the Interest Reserve to interest accruing on the Loan during the Construction Period on each interest payment date. The Interest Reserve shall not be applied to principal, Fees, Default Rate interest, or interest accruing after the Construction Maturity Date.

(c) **Statement.** Lender shall deliver to Borrower, concurrently with each monthly interest statement, a reconciliation of the Interest Reserve Balance, the interest accrued during the period, and the projected remaining interest cost through the Construction Maturity Date.

(d) **Interest Reserve Adequacy Test.** At each Requisition, and in any event not less frequently than quarterly, Lender shall perform an adequacy test comparing (i) the Interest Reserve Balance to (ii) the projected interest cost through the earlier of the next anticipated Advance date or ninety (90) days from the date of the test, in each case determined at the Applicable Rate then in effect and the then-projected outstanding principal balance (the **"Interest Reserve Adequacy Test"**). **Drafting Note:** The Draw Schedule's own analysis projects a surplus of $221,325 assuming Daily Simple SOFR of 3.50%; the same analysis at 4.35% (the rate used throughout the Credit Memorandum and the Term Sheet) projects a shortfall of approximately $365,830; and the Credit Memorandum projects a shortfall of $565,000.
